content.title: Where to watch Lakers vs. Rockets free stream today
content.text: Updated: Mar. 16, 2026, 8:31 p.m.Published: Mar. 16, 2026, 8:30 p.m.Watch Houston Rockets forward Kevin Durant, left, face off with Los Angeles Lakers forward LeBron James a couple more times this season, starting with Monday, March 16, when these squads play their first of two games in three days against each other. (AP Photo/Jayne Kamin-Oncea)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Khadrice Rollins | KRollins@masslive.comA couple of teams right on top of each other in the West standings meet up on Monday, March 16 at the Toyota Center in Houston where the Houston Rockets are hosting the Los Angeles Lakers.This NBA game is scheduled to start at 9:30 p.m. EDT and will be broadcast on Peacock, Spectrum Sports Network and Space City Home Network. Fans looking to watch can do so for free by using DIRECTV, which offers a free trial, or FuboTV, which also offers a free trial as well as up to $30 off your first month. Peacock has plans starting at $10.99 a month and has exclusive NBA games on Mondays and also allows fans to watch games that are broadcast on NBC. Luka Doncic had 30 points, 13 assists, 11 rebounds, three blocks and the the game-winning jumper, while Austin Reaves went for 32 with seven boards and six helpers. LeBron James had 17, and Marcus Smart had 21 with five steals.The Rockets haven’t played since Friday when they earned a 107-105 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans. Kevin Durant had 32 points, while Amen Thompson added 23, 12 rebounds and eight assists. Off the bench, Reed Sheppard added 18, while starter Jabari Smith Jr. had 16. The squad will once again be without center Alperen Sengun.Houston won the first meeting 119-96 in Los Angeles. They play again on Wednesday in their third and final meeting this season. The Lakers need to win both to win the season series and get the tiebreaker for the playoffs while the Rockets just need to win one of these home games.
